facts.text: The resort is set on the Baja Peninsula, overlooking the Sea of Cortez.
facts.excerpt: Set amongst the pristine natural geography of the Baja Peninsula, overlooking the Sea of Cortez

facts.text: The resort has beachfront access to one of the region's few swimmable beaches.
facts.excerpt: One&Only Palmilla offers unrivalled beachfront access to one of the region’s few swimmable beaches

facts.text: In the 1950s Don Abelardo Rodriguez, son of the Mexican president, turned the site into a private home and eventually the region's first resort.
facts.excerpt: Don Abelardo Rodriguez, son of the Mexican president, spotted this plot of land from helicopter and turned it into a private home and eventually the region's first resort

facts.text: The original home could only be reached by helicopter or yacht, and its seclusion attracted Hollywood stars like John Wayne and Lucille Ball.
facts.excerpt: could only be reached by helicopter or yacht (the Transpeninsular Highway wasn't built until 1970) and the seclusion attracted Hollywood stars like John Wayne and Lucille Ball

facts.text: The resort has hacienda-style architecture and an old chapel.
facts.excerpt: The hacienda-style architecture and old chapel make you feel like you're in a colonial pueblo

facts.text: Los Cabos International Airport is 17 miles away, about a 20-minute drive.
facts.excerpt: Los Cabos International Airport, 17 miles away (a 20-minute drive)

facts.text: The resort is about a 10- to 12-minute drive from San Jose del Cabo, whose Thursday night art walks guests can join, and staff can curate gallery tours.
facts.excerpt: It's about a 10- to 12-minute drive from San José del Cabo, which is nice because you can go for the Thursday night art walks or the staff can curate gallery tours.

facts.text: The spa offers a temazcal experience, for which a shaman can be brought in.
facts.excerpt: I think the temazcal experience really stands apart...they'll even bring in a shaman

facts.text: Guests can surf right off the resort's beach.
facts.excerpt: They have one of the only swimmable beaches in Cabo, which is a huge draw and you can also surf right off the beach.

facts.text: Complimentary 10-minute foot massages are offered by the pool.
facts.excerpt: they offer complimentary 10-minute foot massages by the pool

facts.text: The hotel can organize marine life and snorkeling excursions to Cabo Pulmo.
facts.excerpt: The hotel can organize incredible marine life/snorkeling excursions to Cabo Pulmo

facts.text: The hotel can arrange an overnight yacht charter for guests.
facts.excerpt: They can also arrange an overnight yacht charter for guests.

facts.text: Room furnishings include steel-studded wood doors and intricately carved wooden mirror frames.
facts.excerpt: The furnishings felt handcrafted: steel studded wood doors and intricately carved wooden frames around mirrors.

facts.text: Suviche serves a Mexican-Japanese menu.
facts.excerpt: the Mexican-Japanese menu at Suviche

facts.text: Seared is one of the resort's dinner restaurants.
facts.excerpt: I'd go back to Suviche and Seared for dinner

facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly, offering pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.
facts.excerpt: Furry family members are more than welcome at our pet-friendly resort, which offers pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.

facts.text: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi service is available throughout the resort.

facts.text: All payments must be made by credit card; the resort does not accept cash.
facts.excerpt: All payments must be paid by credit card, One&Only Palmilla does not accept cash payments.

facts.text: Staff are fluent in English and Spanish.
facts.excerpt: Staff members are fluent in both English and Spanish.

facts.text: The resort's address is Kilometro 7.5 Carretera Transpeninsular, San Jose del Cabo.
facts.excerpt: Kilometro 7.5 Carretera Transpeninsular, 23400 San Jose del Cabo, B.C.S., Mexico

facts.text: The resort has been named a Forbes Five-Star Resort and Spa for six consecutive years.
facts.excerpt: One&Only Palmilla is proud to have been named a Forbes Five-Star Resort and Spa for six consecutive years.

facts.text: One&Only acquired the property in 2004.
facts.excerpt: One&Only acquired the property in 2004.
